crime: Every morning, {WITCH_NAME}'s mother braided her hair, until the day she put the brush in her daughter's hand. "You can do it yourself now." After that, her mother came to her room less each week, and then not at all.

In the prison, one girl sat on the upper railing above the courtyard every evening, her back to the drop, wearing a crown of daisies until the flowers closed at dusk. She threaded one for {WITCH_NAME} too, and kept her company there.
One morning, as the cells opened, the girl put the daisies in {WITCH_NAME}'s hands and showed her how to thread them. "You can make your own now."

While the others queued for the first hot water, {WITCH_NAME} gripped her wrists at the railing and pushed her back until she was tipping over the drop, then faded her out of the world. The girl was gone before she could fall.

{WITCH_NAME} sat among the prisoners through dinner, and afterward by the courtyard fountain until after dark, never once out of their sight. Without getting up from the fountain, she brought the girl back at the railing, tipping backward over the drop just as she had left her. The girl fell screaming from the empty railing, landed head first on the path, and lay still.
The prisoners decided she had slipped from her perch, just as they had always warned her she would.
A prisoner took out her phone and photographed the daisy crown lying beside the body. Hours after dusk, every flower in it was wide open.
In the trial court, they realized what had happened: she had faded the girl mid-fall long before dusk, and let her fall after dark.
fields.epitaph: She let go first, and was left all the same.
fields.epithet: The Girl Handed Her Own Brush
execution: A giant daisy rises over the fountain, its stem arching above the basin. She lies bound face up in its open heart. The light dims to dusk. One by one, the petals fold shut over her, until the flower is a closed bud. Then the daisy nods, bowing its head down into the basin until the bud is under the water. It hangs there, bowed and still, as the water settles calm over the bud.

magic.name: Into Thin Air
magic.text: She can fade anyone or anything she touches out of the world, and back again unchanged.
